description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller class 'ShoppingCategoryController' responsible for handling HTTP requests related to category pages in an e-commerce web application. It includes methods for displaying categories (with or without references), fetching subcategories, listing products within categories, and filtering products by various criteria. It interacts with services like CategoryService, ProductService, ManufacturerService, and others to retrieve and process catalog data, and produces views or JSON responses accordingly.

classes.name: ShoppingCategoryController
classes.description: Controller class managing category-related web endpoints, providing functionality for browsing categories, listing products, and filtering by criteria in an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: displayCategoryWithReference
methods.description: Handles requests for category pages with a reference parameter, delegates to displayCategory.

methods.name: displayCategoryNoReference
methods.description: Handles requests for category pages without a reference, delegates to displayCategory.

methods.name: displayCategory
methods.description: Core method that retrieves a category by URL, builds breadcrumb, retrieves subcategories, products, and manufacturers, then returns the view.

methods.name: getManufacturersByProductAndCategory
methods.description: Retrieves a list of manufacturers associated with products in given categories.

methods.name: getManufacturers
methods.description: Fetches manufacturers for specified product categories from the manufacturer service.

methods.name: getProductsByCategory
methods.description: Counts products within categories and subcategories for display.

methods.name: getSubCategories
methods.description: Retrieves subcategories under a category and enriches them with product counts.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Public REST endpoint returning all categories for a store and language as JSON.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: REST endpoint returning list of products in a category, including nested subcategories, as JSON.

methods.name: getProducts (overloaded with pagination and filters)
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of products in a category, with optional filters like brand.

methods.name: getProducts (with start, max, filters)
methods.description: Core method doing the business logic for paginated, filtered product lists, returning JSON.

methods.name: getProductsFilteredByType
methods.description: Handles filtering products by specific attribute (e.g., brand) via URL parameters.
